SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 192...
Date....6. 5. 29....

May 6, 8

Sir,

I have the honour to bring to your attention
that information has been received from a fairly
reliable source that Leon Fuchs and Michail Rubin
alias Antoshka, pickpockets and shoplifters of
Russian nationality, left Shanghai on April 11 for
South China, probably Canton, on one of the following
steamers:-

| Name of Ship. | Agents. | Destination. |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| s.s. "Siu Yang" | Butterfield & Swire Co. | Swatow, etc. |
| s.s. "Taishun" | C.M.S.N. Co. | Canton |
| s.s. "Hopsang" | S. M. Co/ | Swatow, etc. |
| Pres. Lincoln | | Hongkong. |

It is suspected that they purchased the tickets
after boarding the steamer by which they travelled,
as their names do not appear on any of the passenger
lists.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

Director of Criminal Intelligence,
Police Headquarters,
Hongkong.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. 192...
日期....1929年5月6日....

5月6日，8点

先生：

谨此提请注意，据一相当可靠的消息来源获悉，俄国籍扒手及商店窃贼 Leon Fuchs 和 Michail Rubin（别名 Antoshka）已于4月11日离开上海前往华南地区，目的地可能是广州，乘坐的是以下轮船之一：

| 船名 | 代理行 | 目的地 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| “Siu Yang”号轮船 | 太古洋行 (Butterfield & Swire Co.) | 汕头等地 |
| “Taishun”号轮船 | 招商局轮船公司 (C.M.S.N. Co.) | 广州 |
| “Hopsang”号轮船 | S. M. Co/ | 汕头等地 |
| “Pres. Lincoln”号 | | 香港 |

怀疑他们是在登船后购买的船票，因为他们的名字未出现在任何乘客名单上。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
代理刑事侦缉处处长。

收信人：
刑事情报处处长，
警察总部，
香港。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY.
Received Oct. 29th.
Date May 2, 1929）

Subject (in full) Departure of Russian Pick-pockets.

Made by D. S. Cvsiannikoff Forwarded by Jno Robertson C.D.I.

With reference to your questionnaire on the
attached report of April 29, I beg to report that I received
information to the effect that Michail Rukin alias Antoshka
and Leon Fuchs left Shanghai for Canton by a Chinese steamer
and in duty bound, reported it. I have been unable to establish
by the process of elimination the ship on which they left but
respectfully submit a list of the vessels which left Shanghai
for South China on that date.

| Name of Ship | Agents | Destination |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| S.S. Siu Yang | Butterfield & Swire Co. | Swatow, etc. |
| S.S. Taishun | C.M.S.N. Co. | Canton |
| S.S. Hopsang | S. I. Co. | Swatow, etc. |
| Pres. Lincoln | | Hongkong |

V. Orloffsky
Det. Sergt.

A.C. (Vts)
I appreciate the difficulties
of all such reports but it is
not as easy to send on a
report which does not keep
returning several times & which
shows that intelligent deduction
has been tried.
3/5 Aay

报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室。
收到日期：10月29日。
日期：1929年5月2日）

主题（全称）俄国扒手离境。

制作人：D. S. Cvsiannikoff 转呈人：Jno Robertson，刑事侦缉处处长。

关于贵方就附上的4月29日报告所提出的问询，谨报告如下：我收到消息称，Michail Rukin（别名 Antoshka）和 Leon Fuchs 已乘中国轮船离开上海前往广州，并按职责规定进行了上报。我未能通过排除法确定他们乘坐的船只，但恭敬地提交了一份当日离开上海前往华南地区的船只清单。

| 船名 | 代理行 | 目的地 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| “Siu Yang”号轮船 | 太古洋行 (Butterfield & Swire Co.) | 汕头等地 |
| “Taishun”号轮船 | 招商局轮船公司 (C.M.S.N. Co.) | 广州 |
| “Hopsang”号轮船 | S. I. Co. | 汕头等地 |
| “Pres. Lincoln”号 | | 香港 |

V. Orloffsky
警佐

A.C. (Vts)
我理解所有此类报告的困难之处，
但发送一份不会多次退回、
且表明已尝试进行合理推断的报告，
并非易事。
3/5 Aay

AR. 2 2/4
代理刑事侦缉处处长
1929年5月2日
1929年5月6日

Date April 29, 1929）
File No.

Subject (in full) Departure of Russian pick-pockets.

Made by D. J. Ovsianikoff Forwarded by Tho Robertson, C.D.I.

Further inquiries go to show that Michail Rubin
alias Antoshka and Leon Fuchs left Shanghai for Canton on
April 11 by a Chinese steamer, the name of which is unknown
at present.

V. Ovsianikoff
D. S.

A/D.C.I.

lea
H.R. 29/4
M/R C 1
Inquiries at the various shipping offices
have failed to reveal the name of the vessel
on which they left. It is suspected they
purchased their tickets on board hence the
reason their names do not appear on any
of the passenger lists.
H. Robertson
D.I.

689. Robertson
(Foreign Section)
Is it definitely known that they
left by a Chinese steamer? What are the names
of the Chinese steamers which left for Canton or
ports convenient to Canton on April 11? Would
it not be possible by a process of elimination to establish
the identity of the steamer by which they left? JM

进一步调查显示，Michail Rubin（别名 Antoshka）和 Leon Fuchs 于4月11日乘坐一艘中国轮船离开上海前往广州，该船名称目前不详。

他们的名字未出现在任何
乘客名单上。
H. Robertson
督察

689. Robertson
(外籍科)
是否确知他们
是乘坐中国轮船离开的？4月11日离开前往广州或

是否不可能通过排除法来确定
他们乘坐的轮船身份？ JM
